understanding: Build uart_serial_data monitor observing stx_pad_o and driving srx_pad_i timing via programmed divisor to reconstruct TX RX bytes with framing break attributes, after wishbone divisor bring-up, using symbolic line format pending source confirmation
preconditions: Clock is active and reset has completed generically; reset polarity unresolved so use asserted versus deasserted only; monitor discards partial frames on reset and realigns to next start bit

Bindings: wb_clk_i driven by clock, wb_rst_i driven by reset, wb_adr_i 3-bit pin values plus wb_dat_i wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_sel_i owned by wishbone_slave_interface, srx_pad_i driven by uart_serial_data, cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i owned by modem_control_if, stx_pad_o plus wb_dat_o wb_ack_o int_o observed

Divisor programmed nonzero via DLAB sequence per f_divisor_access f_divisor_order f_divisor_lsb_addr f_divisor_msb_addr f_dlab_access with DLAB restored to 0; divisor 0 disables I/O per f_divisor_reset; BIT_CYCLES held symbolic from f_divisor_baud using clock

Line format data_bits parity stop_bits held symbolic pending source confirmation; configuration bus writes must agree with uart_serial_data monitor settings; bus addresses are pin values LSB equals 0 MSB equals 1
stimulus_steps: FOR bring-up: wishbone_slave_interface drives LCR DLAB equals 1 write then MSB write to pin address 1 then LSB write to pin address 0 then LCR DLAB equals 0 write using symbolic nonzero divisor per f_divisor_order; WAIT for wb_ack_o; leave bus idle-owned

FOR RX exercise: uart_serial_data driver drives srx_pad_i frames using symbolic data_bits parity stop_bits timed by symbolic BIT_CYCLES derived from programmed divisor per f_divisor_baud; WAIT for monitor to emit RX byte transaction to analysis port

FOR TX observation: observe stx_pad_i versus stx_pad_o frames passively timed by same BIT_CYCLES; monitor emits TX byte transaction to analysis port without driving; IF reset asserted THEN discard partial frames and WAIT for next start bit
Virtual coordination spawns wishbone payload and uart frame traffic concurrently; stages execute in order with no VIFs or delays in virtual sequence; per-agent sequences drive only own interface
coverage_steps: SAMPLE rc_divisor_bytes on divisor-byte write completion via subscriber tapping wishbone monitor analysis port filtered by address 0 versus 1 with DLAB equals 1
Cover lsb_zero_0x00 lsb_mid_0x01_0xFE lsb_max_0xFF msb_zero_0x00 msb_mid_0x01_0xFE msb_max_0xFF combined_zero_disables combined_nonzero_enables; drivers never supply coverage
completion: Done when divisor bring-up ACKed with DLAB equals 0 and uart_serial_data monitor has emitted TX plus RX byte transactions to analysis port or TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES expires
Bound by TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES and drain_cycles as testbench operational limits not DUT timing; on reset WAIT then discard partial frames and realign to next start bit
Cleanup leaves DLAB equals 0 with wishbone bus idle-owned by wishbone_slave_interface and srx_pad_i idle-owned by uart_serial_data

facts.statement: Divisor latches are accessed by setting LCR bit 7 to 1
facts.quote: The divisor latches can be accessed by setting the 7th bit of LCR to ‘1’.

facts.statement: Two divisor bytes form one 16-bit register accessed as single number
facts.quote:
The 2 bytes form one 16-bit register, which is
internally accessed as a single number.

facts.statement: Divisor register resets to 0 which disables all serial I/O operations
facts.quote:
The register is set to the default value of 0 on reset, which
disables all serial I/O operations in order to ensure explicit setup of the register in the
software.

facts.statement: Programmed divisor equals system clock speed divided by 16 times desired baud rate
facts.quote: The value set should be equal to (system clock speed) / (16 x desired baud rate).

facts.statement: Divisor programming writes MSB first and LSB last with counter starting on LSB write
facts.quote:
The internal counter starts to work when the LSB of DL is written, so when setting the
divisor, write the MSB first and the LSB last.

facts.statement: STX_PAD_O is 1-bit output serial output and SRX_PAD_I is 1-bit input serial input
facts.quote:
STX_PAD_O 1 Output The serial output signal
SRX_PAD_I 1 Input The serial input signal

facts.statement: Divisor LSB byte is at WISHBONE pin address 0 with 8-bit width
facts.quote: Divisor Latch Byte 1 (LSB) 0 8 RW The LSB of the divisor

facts.statement: Divisor MSB byte is at WISHBONE pin address 1 with 8-bit width
facts.quote: Divisor Latch Byte 2 1 8 RW The MSB of the divisor

facts.statement: Divisor registers are accessed when LCR DLAB bit 7 is set to 1
facts.quote:
The registers can be accessed when the 7th (DLAB) bit of the Line Control Register is set
to ‘1’.
